picks.file: Bild från familjen von Hallwyls resa genom Mindre Asien och Turkiet 27 April - 20 Juni 1901 - Hallwylska museet - 103229.tif
picks.what: Hamidiye Street and the hillside town, photograph (Hallwyl Museum, Stockholm)
picks.why: sharp large print; main street with the town climbing the hill behind

picks.what: The clock tower and the town in snow, photograph
picks.why: the city’s landmark clock tower with the hillside center behind; high resolution

gaps: P0–P3: nothing usable (saints’ martyrdom scenes and an imaginary palace fire only); P5: only maps, a portrait and a warship
notes: #5 is a Berggren commercial print bought on the von Hallwyl family’s 1901 trip, so it was made by then, probably in the 1890s; labeled about 1900. Alternative P4: #8 (palace ruins with the town on the hill, from Barth’s 1913 book, lower resolution, photo date unknown). #9 (Texier street engraving) skipped: street scene, and 1882 is a reprint date.
